title: Pattern Printer
description:
Menu to print shapes of user-chosen size N:
```
Square (4)   Triangle (4)  Pyramid (4)      Diamond (3)    Hollow box (4)
****         *                *               *            ****
****         **              ***             ***           *  *
****         ***            *****           *****          *  *
****         ****          *******           ***           ****
                                              *
```
requirements: One function per shape: `void printPyramid(int n)`
